identity_check: Exact live IDs and version 1 matched across both Python processes. Public IDs are aliases; original observations and bindings are retained in the scoped Cortex evidence issue.
limitations: Acknowledgment discarded locally after successful create reply; not a real network interruption.
One worker, three synthetic creates, no live update exercise and no atomic CAS/concurrency claim.
Immediate readback and one process restart; not long-term durability, disk-loss or power-loss proof.
Host holds credentials; the local Python process receives only authorized tool responses. It is not an unattended service.
Notion integration remains paused; no production activation or canonical promotion.
next_validation: Bounded live update with pinned target baseline and independent metadata readback, then stale-baseline conflict preservation.
